aggregation.qualification: the H200 child receipts were complete before aggregation; the aggregator treats already bitwise-identical arrays containing non-finite masked values as zero-difference and fails closed if non-finite values differ

cache_off_comparator.qualification: quoted comparator from the cache-off acceptance arm; this run measures the changed production route

measurement_contract.device_requirement: one NVIDIA H200 NVL at float64
measurement_contract.route: ForwardProfile.solve_batch through the production tile evaluator
measurement_contract.timing_separation: runtime import, production profile/operator preparation, lowering and compile-or-cache-load are timed once per process; steady execute is measured afterward in paired cache-enabled and cache-disabled launches of the same compiled executable

steady_state_cost.qualification: steady execute toggles only the cache setting after one executable has compiled, isolating per-slice control overhead from lowering, compilation, cache loading and process startup
